info.title: Womu API
info.description:
API de Womu. Todas las rutas cuelgan de `/api/v1`.

## Envelope

Las respuestas correctas son `{"success": true, "data": ...}`. Los endpoints que no
devuelven nada (borrados, por ejemplo) responden `{"success": true}` sin `data`.

Los errores son siempre `{"success": false, "error": {"code", "message", "details"?}}`.
El campo `code` es estable y es contra lo que debes programar; `message` está en
español y puede cambiar. `details` sólo aparece en errores de validación (422) y
contiene los mensajes por campo.

## Autenticación

Bearer token de Laravel Sanctum: `POST /auth/login` devuelve el token en
`data.token`, y se manda en cada petición como `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

## Organización activa

Una cuenta puede pertenecer a varias organizaciones, así que casi todos los endpoints
exigen además la cabecera `X-Organization-Id` con el id de la organización sobre la
que se opera. Sin ella responden 403 `ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED`; con el id de una
organización a la que no perteneces, 403 `ORGANIZATION_ACCESS_DENIED`.

Cada endpoint indica en su descripción el módulo que la organización debe tener
activo y el permiso que necesita el usuario.

## Paginación

Los listados aceptan `page` y `limit` y devuelven `total`, `page`, `limit` y
`totalPages` junto a la colección.

get.description:
Devuelve el usuario, sus organizaciones, y —si se manda `X-Organization-Id`— la organización
activa con sus módulos y permisos. A diferencia del resto, no exige la cabecera: una cuenta
recién registrada la usa para descubrir que le toca hacer el onboarding.

get.description:
Paginado, filtrable y ordenable. `summary` son los KPIs del mismo conjunto filtrado
(facturado, cobrado, pendiente y vencido), siempre sobre facturas nativas: las importadas
(`origin = imported`) son archivo histórico y no suman.

Requiere módulo `invoicing` activo en la organización y permiso `invoices:read`.

parameters.description:
native (default) shows the working list, imported the historical
archive, all both.

post.description:
Envío síncrono, pensado para reintentar a mano lo que la cola dejó en error. Los envíos de
una organización se serializan: si hay otro en vuelo responde 429 y hay que reintentar.
Un 422 significa que la AEAT rechazó el registro (mira `data.errors`); un 502, que no se
pudo hablar con ella y la factura sigue siendo reintentable.

Requiere módulo `invoicing` activo en la organización y permiso `invoices:update`.

bearerAuth.description: Token de Sanctum devuelto por `POST /auth/login` en `data.token`.

organizationId.description: Id de la organización sobre la que se opera. Las organizaciones del usuario vienen en `data.organizations` de `GET /auth/me`.
organizationId.name: X-Organization-Id

inventSecret.description: Secreto compartido con UseInvent. Uso interno del agente, no para integradores.
inventSecret.name: X-Invent-Secret

AcceptPublicSalesDocumentRequest.description:
Validates the client's acceptance on the public portal. Authorization is the
token itself (resolved by the `sales-document.token` middleware), so there is
no per-user gate here.
AcceptPublicSalesDocumentRequest.title: AcceptPublicSalesDocumentRequest

periodKey.description:
Optional explicit period (e.g. '2026'); defaults to the current
period of the series' reset policy.

mapping.description:
canonical field => source header. Keys are constrained to known
fields; values are the user's column names.

provider.description:
No redirectUrl: where the bank returns the user is server-side
config (`banking.providers.*.redirect_url`), because it must match
the provider's registered allowlist. See ConnectBankCommandHandler.

CreateMemberRequest.description:
Admin-driven member creation. Password strength mirrors the frontend
form and ChangePasswordRequest (min 8, upper, lower, digit). The role
must be one of the assignable system roles — the SAME set `GET /roles`
offers: web guard, no team (`organization_id` null). Restricting it
here turns a foreign-guard / team-scoped id into a clean 422 instead of
Spatie's `RoleDoesNotExist` blowing up as an untranslated 500 in
OrganizationRoleService::assign.
CreateMemberRequest.title: CreateMemberRequest

intervalMonths.description: Required only for a custom cadence; ignored otherwise.

code.description: Código estable del error. Es contra lo que debes programar.

message.description: Mensaje en español, pensado para enseñárselo al usuario.

details.description: Sólo en errores de validación (422): mensajes por campo.

ExpenseStatus.description: Payment lifecycle of an expense. `Pending` means the expense is recorded but not yet settled; `Paid` means it has been settled (with an optional `paid_at` date on the row).
ExpenseStatus.title: ExpenseStatus

InvoiceOrigin.description: Where an invoice came from. - Native   issued inside Womu through the VeriFactu pipeline. Counts toward            KPIs and is reconcilable. - Imported brought in from a previous system as a read-only historical            record. No QR, never sent to AEAT, out of the hash chain, and            excluded from KPIs and bank reconciliation.
InvoiceOrigin.title: InvoiceOrigin

InvoiceStatus.description: Lifecycle of an invoice. Numbering is consumed when transitioning from `Draft` to `Issued`; `Cancelled` keeps the assigned number to avoid gaps in the legal sequence.
InvoiceStatus.title: InvoiceStatus

PaymentSource.description: Where a payment record came from. `Manual` is a human marking the invoice paid; everything else is produced by an automated source (statement import, open banking sync, or a payment gateway webhook).
PaymentSource.title: PaymentSource

RecurrenceCadence.description: How often a recurring invoice template generates an invoice. `Custom` defers to the template's `interval_months`; the rest map to a fixed span.
RecurrenceCadence.title: RecurrenceCadence

RejectPublicSalesDocumentRequest.description:
Validates the client's rejection on the public portal: the name is required
(proof of who answered), the reason is optional.
RejectPublicSalesDocumentRequest.title: RejectPublicSalesDocumentRequest

SalesDocumentStatus.description: Lifecycle of a sales document. Editable only while `Draft`: once `Sent`, the public page and PDF render live and the client may accept it, so the content is frozen (change it by duplicating). `Rejected`, `Expired` and `Converted` are terminal. There is no fiscal numbering, so transitions carry no AEAT consequences.
SalesDocumentStatus.title: SalesDocumentStatus

SalesDocumentType.description: The kind of commercial (non-fiscal) document. Drives the number prefix and the human label shown on the PDF / UI. Both share the same engine.
SalesDocumentType.title: SalesDocumentType

exclude.description: Exclude the row from the import, or patch canonical fields.

reviewed.description: Sign off an extracted row without changing anything.

UpdateMemberRequest.description:
Admin-driven member edit. Exposes the admin-only levers `isActive` and
`roleId` — kept apart from the self-service profile request so a user
can never set their own role or active flag. When present, `roleId` is
restricted to the assignable system roles (web guard, no team) — the
same set `GET /roles` offers — so a foreign id is a 422, not a 500.
UpdateMemberRequest.title: UpdateMemberRequest

UpdateProfileRequest.description:
Self-service profile edit. Only exposes the fields a user may change
about themselves — never `isActive`, which is an admin-only flag.
UpdateProfileRequest.title: UpdateProfileRequest

UpdateRecurringInvoiceTemplateRequest.description:
Update fully replaces the template's editable fields and line set, so it
shares the create rule set.

intervalMonths.description: Required only for a custom cadence; ignored otherwise.

UpdateRecurringInvoiceTemplateRequest.title: UpdateRecurringInvoiceTemplateRequest

UpdateSalesDocumentRequest.description:
Update fully replaces the editable fields and the line set, so it validates
the same payload as create (the DTO `CreateSalesDocumentData` backs both).
UpdateSalesDocumentRequest.title: UpdateSalesDocumentRequest

ValidationException.description: Datos inválidos. `error.details` trae los mensajes campo a campo. Códigos posibles: `VALIDATION_ERROR`.

AuthenticationException.description: No autenticado: falta el token, ha caducado o no es válido. Códigos posibles: `UNAUTHENTICATED`.
